paragraphs:
Look, with ABC coming up, everything we do with bodyweight has to serve one thing: making your legs and joints bulletproof on stone staircases without setting off your right knee, back, or elbow. I just locked in a dedicated bodyweight routine for you called Bodyweight Trek Foundation.

Run this three times a week with an honest 3-second descent on each rep. How does that feel to start with?

messages.text: Can you build me a new bodyweight strength routine I can do at home, no equipment, three times a week?
